## Work

- **Hytec Power Inc. Virtual Tour** — interactive 3D tour built with Google Model
  Viewer and Photo Sphere Viewer, backed by a Laravel CMS. Live at
  https://virtual-tour.e-hytec.dev/tour
- **VIDERE** — digital art platform for creating, sharing, selling, and
  collaborating on artwork. React/Vite frontend, Node.js/Express API, and a
  Python/Flask ML service (MobileNetV2, collaborative filtering, FAISS,
  K-Means). Live at https://viderevision.vercel.app/ · GitHub:
  https://github.com/SyzygyG/Videre
- **QCU Journals** — scholarly, peer-reviewed journal platform for Quezon City
  University, built on PKP Open Journal Systems. Live at https://qcujournals.com/
